name: Agent Workforce (internal trial)
note: Workforce-internal project bundling team-shared resources used by trial CCR-bound skills. Holds the team Discord webhook URL (consumed by Yuki's discord-heartbeat), the feed-write token (Dario's feed-post), and two Notion integration-token variants for Elena's 2-hourly article-level2 (L1→L2 explanation, via the CCR agent-runner): @l1 = {apiKey, databaseId=L1 source library}, @l2 = {apiKey, databaseId=unified Articles DB}. Same Notion integration (apiKey) shared to both DBs; pick-l1-source.mjs reads L1 + unified, publish-notion.mjs writes the explanation to unified. orchestrator-tick resolves wf/projects/agent-workforce/notion.integration_token@{l1,l2} and ships them inline. Members grow as more agents flip skills to the CCR path. Not a customer project — this is the operational substrate the workforce itself runs on.
